title: Briefing for 2026-10-23
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-10-23: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.
us: Trump's approval rating on economy hits all-time low as midterm looms: CNBC survey. UK inflation jumps to 3.5% — cementing rate hike expectations. Housing is flashing warning signs just as the Fed weighs more interest rate hikes. India’s finance minister says market liquidity makes it easier for investors to exit. U.S. budget deficit swells to almost $2 trillion for fiscal 2026, up 12% in a single year. CoreWeave set off a wave of anxiety — but Wall Street’s dire prognosis is premature.

Trump ordered to answer questions under oath in BBC lawsuit. Race to update services' computer systems after cyber-security flaw found. Crowd of 50 beats foreigner to death in South Africa. The 'trillion pound' oil fund the government believes Britain could have built.

outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
